title: ConsoleWhileLoad
description: ConsoleWhileLoad adds a separate startup console window when Minecraft launches on Fabric.
body:
# ConsoleWhileLoad

  ConsoleWhileLoad adds a separate startup console window when Minecraft launches on Fabric.

  As soon as the game begins loading, a black boot-style window opens and shows live startup logs in green text. When
  boot finishes, the window can either close automatically or stay open if you enable that in the config.

  ## Features

  - Separate startup console window
  - Black background with green terminal-style text
  - Live Minecraft/Fabric startup logs
  - Opens during early game boot
  - Optional keep-open behavior after loading finishes

  ## Config

  Config file:
  config/consolewhileload.properties

  Option:
  keep_window_open_after_boot=false

  Set it to true if you want the console window to stay open after Minecraft finishes loading.

  - Client-side only
  - Fabric mod

  If you like seeing what Minecraft is doing while it launches, or you want a cleaner separate boot log window instead
  of only watching terminal output, ConsoleWhileLoad gives startup its own retro console-style display.
